description: What a rooftop solar system in Germany earns for the power it feeds into the grid over 20 years: today's fixed payment for systems running by 31 Dec 2026, or the government draft EEG 2027 for later ones. Illustration with Munich yields, not a quote.

afterTransition.description: From 2027: sell through a direct marketer, or hand the power over for free

fullFeedIn.description: Feed everything into the grid (only for systems starting in 2026)

orientation.description: Roof orientation (yield from PVGIS for Munich)

selfUseShare.description: Share of the yield used at home, 0 to 1

startYear.description: Year the system starts operating, any year from 2026. 2026: today's fixed payment; from 2027 the draft rules (2030 follows the 2029 rules, 2031 and later the same rules). A year already past is moved to the earliest possible one. Default: the earliest possible.

name: eeg_feed_in
title: Feed-in payment (EEG)
